# Observability & Resilience Requirements Checklist: Datadog Agent Sidecar for Backstage

**Purpose**: Validate the quality (completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability) of metrics-delivery, secrets, and failure-isolation requirements before implementation
**Created**: 2026-11-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the exact metric names/namespaces that constitute "task/container CPU, memory, and health" and "deployment metrics" enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for which environments (dev, prod, others) must be onboarded and how each is identified? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK003 Are egress/network reachability requirements to Datadog documented as a requirement rather than only a plan note? [Gap, Plan §Deployment impact]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements specified for agent image source, version pinning, and update policy? [Gap, Research §D1]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for the agent's own log output destination and retention? [Gap, Research §D6]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "health" metrics defined (container health status vs. agent health vs. ALB target health)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "consistent with existing Datadog alarm and dashboard conventions" resolved to explicit tag keys and values rather than a reference to specs 003/004? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "enough capacity ... without starving the application" quantified with concrete CPU/memory figures? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "agent failure" defined (crash, unhealthy, unreachable Datadog, invalid key) with the expected behavior for each? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "valid Datadog configuration" defined, including how validity is determined at deployment time? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "current" data in the independent test quantified (e.g., maximum metric staleness)? [Measurability, Spec §US1]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Do the "MUST NOT appear in plain-text task configuration" requirement and the plan's acceptance of a plain env var key conflict? [Conflict, Spec §FR-004, §SC-004, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the "existing CI/deployment secret injection path" consistent with FR-004's requirement for a "secure secret store"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK014 Do the spec's "AWS-side integration not required" assumption and the requirement for ECS service-level (desired/running, deployment) metrics conflict? [Conflict, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-002, Research §D7]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the term "service name" consistently mapped to the same tag across US1, FR-003, and the alarm/dashboard specs? [Consistency, Spec §US1]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 Can SC-002 ("100% of tasks") be objectively measured, including the observation window and the data source of truth? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK017 Can SC-003 ("no additional downtime") be objectively measured with a baseline and duration? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK018 Is SC-004 verifiable for deployed state (e.g., task definition revisions, CI logs), not only the repository? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK019 Does the SC-001 10-minute window state its start event and whether it applies to first deploy only or every rollout? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for the agent failing at task startup while the app starts normally, including task health reporting? [Coverage, Spec §US2]
- [ ] CHK021 Are rollback/recovery requirements defined if the new task definition fails deployment? [Gap, Recovery, Plan §Deployment impact]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements specified for API key rotation or revocation without service disruption? [Gap, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for the invalid-key-at-runtime case regarding detection/alerting that metrics are missing? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the requirement for a missing key ("deployment is rejected") specified with where and how the rejection occurs? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements defined for task replacement/scaling events so metrics continuity is preserved? [Gap, Spec §SC-002]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK026 Are security requirements stated for the agent's IAM permissions and any exposed ports? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK027 Are cost or metric-volume limits (custom metrics, host/container billing) addressed? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK028 Are data-handling requirements defined for what task metadata/labels are sent to Datadog? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK029 Is the assumption that a Datadog account/key and secret store already exist validated or owned by a named party? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the dependency on the cluster-owned execution role (for a future secret-store migration) documented as a requirement boundary? [Dependency, Research §D4]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the out-of-scope status of logs, tracing, and custom metrics consistent with the agent's log-group and label configuration? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Research §D6]
- [ ] CHK032 Are FR-008 documentation requirements specific about required parameters, verification steps, and expected results? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK033 Is a requirement-and-acceptance-criteria traceability scheme established mapping FR/SC items to the contract checks? [Traceability, Gap]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
